acceptance_scope: Offline fixed v6c handoff implementation and exact accepted-input binding only. No execution, credential read, preparation, runtime policy change or service operation authorized.

table_reference.limit: Referenced hash-bound table only; pins/witnesses are not duplicated or recaptured. Its existing 43 direct v6c/89 inherited provenance and all policy limits remain intact.

binding_review.helper_import: Bytes checked before exec/compile into a non-main module name. Only generic checked_json/parse_inputs/source_format/parse_token/handoff are called; old inputs(), old execute() and the v6b wrapper are not invoked.
binding_review.comparison_with_v6b: helpers(), execute() and validate_only() match the frozen v6b versions exactly after v6c-to-v6b label substitution. Changes are packet/record/attempt constants and validated(): scope-referenced subject table, V2 schema/network agreement, accepted review/receipt cross-binding and inert receipt argv instead of a full command prefix.
binding_review.accepted_record_binding: Pinned receipt/review/scope/runtime; exact seven-subject table hash; thirteen current consumer hashes; actual cutover.load_inputs binds accepted v6c plan, preparation evidence/review, seven child hashes, topical record and staged rows. Every child/runtime reviewer embeds the exact scope digest. Worker-mode attempt, CLI hash, 132 source pins and exact network bindings are required.
binding_review.default_inertness: No execution flag invokes validate_only and the existing default CLI only. Independent tests forbid native transport/backend/token/lock/reservation calls and exercise actual accepted inputs. Saved default stdout is inert and equals the accepted inert receipt stdout.
binding_review.future_pre_token_refusal: validated() completes before any token source read. Existing cutover attempt path is rejected with lexists, including a dangling symlink; CLI verification must pass before the one source inspect.

future_token_source.name: phase1-orchestrator
future_token_source.binding: Exact identity/image comes from the hash-bound accepted original baseline, not the replacement orchestrator. Source-format checks ID/image/running before emitting only the named service-token entry.

binding_review.future_private_handoff: One bounded source inspect, strict single-row JSON SERVICE_TOKEN parser, 1..4096 printable ASCII characters without spaces, then one anonymous-pipe transfer to unchanged cutover.main. No resend/fallback or token argv/env/file/log/hash export. Writer closes; read-descriptor ownership transfers to the existing entrypoint, which consumes/closes it. Core dumps disabled before the future execution branch. Exceptions/source payloads are not printed; failure marker is generic.

verification.environment: VERIFIED_ENV for isolated local synthetic tests only
verification.command: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest --noconftest -c /dev/null -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_companion_v6c_handoff.py
verification.parent_result: CLAIMED in checkpoint: 23 passed in 0.31s; independently confirmed the same twenty-three cases.
verification.cases: Accepted-input/default inertness, helper/record/consumer drift, contradictory receipt/scope/subjects/network/argv, occupied directory/dangling-symlink refusal before source, CLI refusal, one synthetic source/private-pipe handoff, bad token payloads and sanitized native exceptions.
verification.actual_default_module_invocation: Parent-attributed saved stdout only. Reviewer independently exercised validate_only through the synthetic no-native test, not a separate module command.

remaining_limits.detail: Pre-token lexists is advisory/non-atomic. Two concurrent wrappers could both reach token sourcing; only the unchanged controller lock/exclusive reservation controls once-only mutation. No cross-process single credential-read guarantee is claimed.

CLI verification has a separate 10-second bound and token-source inspect a separate 10-second bound. The existing controller has 600 seconds including 180 seconds recovery reserve; file validation and pre-controller work are not covered by a whole-wrapper 600-second deadline. The existing pipe reader has its own timeout.

Reference clearing is not secure memory zeroization. Handoff-entered means the helper boundary was attempted, not successful reservation, mutation, startup or query. Pipe ownership assumptions are inherited unchanged, not a new memory-sanitization guarantee.

No actual CLI/token-source formatting, live imports/SDK startup, service health, final aliases/attachment, clock coherency, installed pidfd/worker ownership, acknowledgement/cancellation/recovery or successful cited query was verified here. Final configuration remains MODELLED until actual fail-closed checks.

Bounded rollback attempts do not guarantee healthy originals, byte-exact/data-volume restoration or reversal of logs, audit/client initialization and all persistent effects. No profitability or general model-readiness claim follows.

The v6c preparation is consumed and must not rerun/reset. Old wrappers/attempts are not rebound or reused. Future runtime invocation requires separate explicit operator approval; this review neither starts an operation nor grants permission.
